text: Place on a floor with a completely empty block above. Machines can stand directly side-by-side or diagonally. The machine is two blocks tall. In Survival, mine the base to collect the machine; the upper half cannot be mined. Breaking and replacing it resets any trading progress and removes any installed upgrade. The recovered item places a base machine; train and upgrade it again after moving.

Stand to trade. Crouch and aim at the upper half to build against it; while flying in Creative, hold Sneak. Offers stay in stock, and every offer is paid in emeralds. Anyone can craft and use it, in any difficulty.
Use an Upgrade Kit on the base to lower its prices until the machine is broken. Survival consumes the kit once; using a kit on an already upgraded machine costs nothing.
